attribute_types.GeneratedId: ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9-]*; allocated by renderer; author names encoded as n- plus UTF-8 lowercase hex
attribute_types.RegisteredClassList: space-separated names registered in the backend stylesheet; not arbitrary source Text
attribute_types.Text: valid UTF-8 and XML 1.0 Char scalars; reject disallowed scalar with InvalidMarkupCharacter; escape according to doc/spec/13-reproducibility.md
attribute_types.FragmentHref: # plus an existing generated id in the same output artifact
attribute_types.Decimal: finite base-10 number, no NaN/Infinity/exponent; canonical trailing zeros removed
attribute_types.ViewBox: four Decimal values min-x min-y width height; width/height > 0
attribute_types.Points: nonempty ordered list of pairs of Decimal values
attribute_types.Path: typed Move/Line/Horizontal/Vertical/Close commands with Decimal arguments only
attribute_types.Paint: none or #RRGGBB; no url(), currentColor or arbitrary CSS
attribute_types.DashList: nonempty list of nonnegative Decimal, at least one > 0
attribute_types.NonnegativeMathLength: canonical nonnegative finite decimal followed by em; no sign, exponent, percentage, leading zeros or redundant trailing fractional zeros; zero is 0em
attribute_types.HtmlHref: typed Fragment/Artifact/BetweenArtifacts/External; lexical constraints and structural checks in doc/spec/19-html-fragment.md; source route binding and target availability remain separate preparation obligations
attribute_types.ArtifactPath: nonempty relative ASCII alphanumeric/-_. path; no empty, dot or parent segments; assigned by artifact preparation, not arbitrary author input

root_slots.HtmlBlock: html flow elements, root math display=block, root svg
root_slots.HtmlPhrasing: validated HTML phrasing including span/a/em/strong/ruby/br/code/img; inline math via its separate profile; no block elements or root svg
root_slots.Math: root math with the required element arities

namespace_transition.html: only root math or root svg starts foreign namespace
namespace_transition.mathml: mtext may contain validated HtmlPhrasing; other elements do not accept arbitrary HTML

trusted_shell: html/head/meta/style/body are emitted by fixed DocumentShell code, not accepted as user Markup nodes; stylesheet body is a fixed backend asset
html_profile: interfaces/markup.json and doc/spec/19-html-fragment.md define the implemented HTML fragment subset. Foreign namespace profiles and full artifact preparation remain required, not silently accepted.
